additional_info.subject: ID0476770-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / S0 170004107] The PP5 - Faulted connector does not work CRM:03289000472
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we checked the charger and performed a soft reboot to the charger.
The soft reboot resolved the issue, and outlet 1 is available and online again.
We will monitor the charger the coming days to see if the error appears again, and take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0476770-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / S0 170004107] The PP5 - Faulted connector does not work CRM:03289000472
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael,
We have monitored the charger for the last couple of hours, and see that the error flag regarding the converters is still there.
The outlets are working operationally. We will forward the request to our colleagues, to do an on-site check.
They will contact you as soon as possible.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0476770-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / S0 170004107] The PP5 - Faulted connector does not work CRM:03209000160
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0476770
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC- CH SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Holcim AG
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
Sicharge D Charging Center - Holcim Siggenthal 3
Charger ID / Serial No.:
RZfz6p
Charger address/functional location: Switserland
Priority:
High
Handover reason: Converter replacement
Following the request of the client, and after our check, we see that converter 4 & 5 are faulty.
Please check the following steps. The following are the three possible solutions for this problem:
Check the AC-DC cables attached to that converter. If properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This confirms if the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty.
Replace the converter. Hereby i send you the serial number of the spare part:
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
